decision.reasoning_trace: During the shopping session, I noticed that a significant number of search results were actually travel cases or accessories rather than the speakers themselves. I narrowed my consideration set down to five actual speakers with varying features: a multi-functional night light speaker, a rugged waterproof option, a premium light-show speaker, a portable clip-on, and a high-fidelity home speaker. I ultimately chose the JBL CLIP 3 (Renewed). Although it is a refurbished unit, it maintains a very high 4.7-star rating with over 1,600 reviews, offering the best value for a reliable, portable brand-name speaker. The higher-end Sony and JBL Pulse 4 models were considered but rejected due to price-to-performance concerns and specific user complaints regarding apps or weight.
